text.style: text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7; font: normal 400 8.5px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Pangram AI share of each section as posted. The low and the latest unflagged scoring are labeled.

text.style: text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7; font: normal 400 8.5px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A hollow dot had the humanizer flag set: such a scoring never counts as a best, and its text wasn't written.
